body_text:
Cantor's theorem. For every set $A$, no function
$f:A\to\mathcal{P}(A)$ is surjective. Indeed, the diagonal set
$D=\{a\in A:a\notin f(a)\}$ differs from $f(a)$ at the element $a$
for every $a\in A$. Hence $|A|<|\mathcal{P}(A)|$, and there is no
largest cardinality.
